flow.name: axn-term - ACP agent session via vibe-acp
flow.description: Real Mistral Vibe over ACP: the axn-acp-session hidden command opens an agent-first session (mainView 'agent', no PTY), the frontend acpClient drives initialize + session/new over the agent's stdio, and the assigned acpSessionId lands in state.json for session/load on remount. Requires the mistral-vibe tool installed and authenticated (vibe-acp on PATH).

step.description: Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
Run axn-acp-session vibe-acp in the shell session — an agent-first session must appear in the window state
acpSessionId appears — initialize + session/new completed against real vibe-acp
The agent session and its ACP id survive in the saved state

assert.description: Persisted state carries the agent session
